def find_max(words):
    return sorted(words, key=lambda x: (-len(set(x)), x))[0]

def test_find_max():
    # Most distinct letters wins
    assert find_max(["ab", "abcd", "abc"]) == "abcd"
    # Repeated letters don't add
    assert find_max(["aaaa", "ab"]) == "ab"
    # Tie -> alphabetically first
    assert find_max(["ba", "ab", "ac"]) == "ab"
    assert find_max(["xyz", "abc", "def"]) == "abc"
    # Single word / empty string
    assert find_max(["only"]) == "only"
    assert find_max(["", "a"]) == "a"
    print("All tests passed")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_find_max()
```
